verdict.rationale: The only source-related evidence is a public GitHub repo, FormantIO/toolkit, which holds peripheral developer code (RealtimeSDK usage, UI custom elements, embeddable modules). Nothing shows the core platform or agent source is public, and no license is cited for the toolkit, so this barely counts. Missing for 10: an open license stated for any repo, public source for the core platform and agent, and any independent confirmation of open-source status.
